feedback: All acceptance tests and unit tests, including the new ones for data reset, backup passphrase validation, numeric validation, and backup structure validation, pass. TypeScript compilation succeeds and static checks report no blocking issues. The code implements the required hardening features: data reset now removes photos and rotates the encryption key while preserving policy acceptance; backup creation enforces a minimum 12‑character passphrase; receipt photos are handled via the new File API; numeric validation functions return the correct error messages; restore validates backup structure before mutating data; export buttons are disabled during export (implementation present). No visual regressions are introduced. No further defects detected.
